description: Check whether a set of patterns work well together. Pass the slugs (or numbers) of patterns you plan to combine on a page and get a compatibility report: overall score, per-pair analysis, style/industry coherence, intensity balance, page-flow coverage, and warnings (duplicate roles, missing positions, too many heavy patterns). Call BEFORE building to catch mismatches early.

components.description: Pattern slugs or numbers to validate together

name: validate_combination
